A page_clusters source with a residual aspirational (unwritten) ToC link fails CLOSED at acquisition -- the public_first completeness gate names every missing page, and the fix is an explicit exclude_pages addition here, never a silent skip. NOT authored -- approved, no viable route 2026-08-16: pf-1013 (כפתור ופרח, ~2% of its ToC is actually written), pf-1015 (מגדל עוז, ~4% written, a 4-level structure unlike every other work here), pf-1031 (תוספות ישנים, ~8% written, thin and uneven per-tractate coverage). NOT authored -- approved, route NOT PINNABLE YET: pf-1032 (תוספות רי"ד -- ~319 real pages exist under the long "...על הש"ס/<tractate>/פרק" title scheme, but a live spot-check 2026-08-16 showed the main ToC page links NONE of them (0 selected per cluster) and the per-tractate sub-index pages link only their first perek; the work needs a dedicated route probe, possibly an apprefix-enumeration acquisition mode, before an entry can be authored).
